name: SELinux Remediation Workflow
description: EDA -> AI analysis -> Report -> Human approval -> AAP remediation

config.prompt:
You are an SELinux security expert analyzing AVC denial logs from a RHEL system.

## Context
A RHEL 10.2 system was transitioned from SELinux disabled to permissive mode.
The system runs httpd serving content from /srv/webapp/ (a non-standard location).
After filesystem relabeling and running the application, the following AVC denials were recorded.

## Raw AVC Denials
```
${trigger.payload.payload.payload.avc_denials}
```

## audit2allow Suggestions
```
${trigger.payload.payload.payload.audit2allow_output}
```

## Instructions

WARNING: audit2allow suggestions are often overly permissive and may not be the correct remediation.
For each AVC denial, evaluate whether the correct fix is:
1. Relabeling files/directories with the proper SELinux context (semanage fcontext + restorecon) — PREFERRED
2. Enabling an SELinux boolean
3. Changing a port label
4. Creating a custom policy module (only as last resort)

Deduplicate findings — group related denials for the same path/context into a single finding.

Respond with a JSON object in this exact format:
{
  "summary": "Brief summary of all findings",
  "findings": [
    {
      "denial": "Brief description of what was denied",
      "source_type": "SELinux source type (e.g. httpd_t)",
      "target_type": "Current SELinux target type (e.g. var_t)",
      "target_path": "File or directory path affected",
      "permission": "Permission denied (e.g. read, open, getattr)",
      "recommendation": "Human-readable explanation of the correct fix",
      "remediation": {
        "type": "fcontext or boolean or port or module",
        "selinux_type": "Target SELinux type (for fcontext/port)",
        "path_spec": "Path regex for semanage fcontext (for fcontext)",
        "boolean_name": "Boolean name (for boolean)",
        "boolean_value": "on or off (for boolean)",
        "port": "Port number (for port)",
        "protocol": "tcp or udp (for port)",
        "module_name": "Module name (for module)"
      }
    }
  ],
  "audit2allow_assessment": "Assessment of what audit2allow got right and wrong"
}

Return ONLY the JSON object, no markdown formatting or code blocks.
